svg.title: Eight-year total cost of ownership by application
svg.desc: Six exact source stacked bars, with legible energy and driver shares. Energy ranges from 10% in EU urban to 21% in US long-haul, while driver cost is 38–53% of total. Other categories are retained in the source bars, not estimated from their pixel widths.
svg.text: Share of the total cost (%), pooled by use
